label: Municipal government
description: A city or county: the emergency operations center, public works, police and fire, 911 dispatch, city IT and the public services residents depend on. Plans: the emergency operations plan (FEMA CPG 101 v3.1), a cyber incident annex, COOP/COG and the hazard mitigation plan; the 911 service provider must notify the PSAP of an outage within 30 minutes (47 CFR 4.9(h)).

vocabulary.facility: the city (its facilities, districts and services)
vocabulary.frontline: 911 dispatchers, public-works crews, police and fire officers, permit clerks, utility-billing staff

it: property tax, assessor and recorder systems
police CAD / RMS and evidence storage
ot: PACS and CCTV at city facilities
fleet fuel management and EV chargers

roles.name: Emergency Management Director (Incident Commander)
roles.description: Owns the EOC and the coordinated response.

roles.name: Director of Public Works
roles.description: Owns streets, water, wastewater, signals and the crews.

roles.name: Chief Information Officer (Technical Lead)
roles.description: Owns the city networks, CAD, billing and the investigation.

roles.name: Public Information Officer
roles.description: Owns resident messaging, social media, 311 and the press.

roles.name: Police Chief (Public Safety)
roles.description: Owns police and the coordination with fire and EMS.

roles.name: Mayor / County Executive (Policy Group)
roles.description: Owns the local emergency declaration and the request for state assistance.

roles.name: Fire Chief
roles.description: Owns fire, EMS, hazmat and fire-station alerting.

roles.name: Finance Director
roles.description: Owns payroll continuity, emergency procurement, wire-fraud holds and FEMA reimbursement.

outsideParties: the county or neighboring cities (mutual aid)
the city council and the mayor's office
the 911 service provider (PSAP outage notice within 30 minutes)
the state fusion center and National Guard cyber unit
the cyber insurer and breach coach
mediaChannels: resident posts on Facebook and Nextdoor
the local newspaper and TV station
